requirements: classification as before or after viewing relevant outcome

analysis_invariants: No technical failure is converted to an analytical label or null value.
No same-model verdict is described as accuracy without human reference.
UNVERIFIABLE is reported with its own denominator.
No placeholder or random analytical result is generated when inputs are absent.
No meta-analysis proceeds before common estimand and study independence checks.
Case and domain summaries disclose weighting and remain descriptive for purposive cases.

data_quality_dimensions.name: completeness
data_quality_dimensions.operationalization: presence of required metadata, source text, and synthesis fields

data_quality_dimensions.name: accuracy
data_quality_dimensions.operationalization: agreement with adjudicated human reference data

data_quality_dimensions.name: validity_and_conformance
data_quality_dimensions.operationalization: type, range, unit, logical ordering, and schema checks

data_quality_dimensions.name: consistency
data_quality_dimensions.operationalization: agreement among linked values such as estimate and interval

data_quality_dimensions.name: uniqueness
data_quality_dimensions.operationalization: report deduplication and underlying-study linkage accuracy

data_quality_dimensions.name: provenance
data_quality_dimensions.operationalization: traceability to source record, text, prompt, model, call, and code version

data_quality_dimensions.name: technical_reliability
data_quality_dimensions.operationalization: successful completion without API, parsing, or schema failure

data_quality_dimensions.name: source_adequacy
data_quality_dimensions.operationalization: whether the supplied title/abstract supports field verification

design.case_selection: 20 purposively selected test cases across five assigned domains
design.generalization_limit: Cases do not constitute a probability sample of disciplines, systematic reviews, or bibliographic corpora. Domain comparisons are descriptive.

evaluator_error_injection.allocation: blocked random assignment to unchanged control or one injected error
evaluator_error_injection.blinding: evaluator is not told assignment or error type
evaluator_error_injection.precision_rule: increase within frozen blocks until reported 95% half-width is at most 0.10

adaptive_precision_rule.restriction: increase sample size by frozen strata only; do not stop based on favorable results

annotators.adjudication: consensus or third reviewer; unresolved remains a reported state

extraction.analysis: retain inverse inclusion probabilities and cluster by record
extraction.sampling: without replacement using stable record-field identities

screening.analysis: retain inverse inclusion probabilities for design-weighted estimates
screening.sampling: without replacement using stable record identities

meta_analysis_eligibility.dependent_estimates: use multilevel or cluster-robust analysis as a secondary model
meta_analysis_eligibility.exclusion_rule: do not pool incompatible effect measures merely because they share a column
meta_analysis_eligibility.primary_estimate_selection: one prespecified estimate per independent study
required: a prespecified common estimand or a defensible conversion to one
at least five independent studies for any synthesis
at least ten independent studies for a primary propagation analysis
documented handling of multiple reports, outcomes, subgroups, and time points

conclusion_rules: whether the confidence interval crosses the null
whether a case-specific substantive threshold is crossed
meta_analysis_models.prediction_interval: report for random-effects models when mathematically estimable
meta_analysis_models.primary: REML random effects with Hartung-Knapp inference
meta_analysis_models.threshold_timing: freeze each substantive threshold before comparing LLM and human results

primary_estimands.target: design-weighted probability that an adjudicated relevant record was labeled INCLUDE
design-weighted probability that a source-assessable extracted field is incorrect

primary_estimands.denominator: human-confirmed incorrect fields with completed evaluator calls
primary_estimands.numerator: human-confirmed incorrect fields labeled INCORRECT by evaluator
primary_estimands.target: probability that the evaluator identifies a human-confirmed incorrect field

primary_estimands.denominator: human-confirmed correct fields with completed evaluator calls
primary_estimands.numerator: human-confirmed correct fields labeled CORRECT by evaluator
primary_estimands.target: probability that the evaluator accepts a human-confirmed correct field

primary_estimands.numerator: pooled effect on analysis scale from LLM data minus human-reference pooled effect
primary_estimands.target: difference between pooled effects from matched LLM and human-adjudicated datasets

primary_estimands.numerator: draws with a changed statistical or substantive conclusion
primary_estimands.target: probability that calibrated pipeline errors change a prespecified conclusion

observed_order: screening-restored dataset where validation supports it
propagation_analyses.rate_uncertainty: bootstrap or hierarchical draws from observed validation data

prospective_model_roles.human_reference_priority: Model comparisons are secondary; no model output replaces human adjudication.

randomness.rule: record every derived seed and never use one mutable global stream across analyses
randomness.stream_derivation: SHA-256 of protocol version, task namespace, case, and replicate

repeatability.seed_note: Model-side nondeterminism is measured; local sampling remains seeded.

required_companion_rates.rule: Report each failure state separately and combined; never impute an analytical value.
Do not exclude UNVERIFIABLE from its own denominator or merge it with failures.
Report not reported, ambiguous, unavailable, and not applicable separately.

research_questions.question: What completeness, validity, uniqueness, provenance, and technical-reliability problems occur across retrieval and corpus construction?
How valid are archived LLM screening decisions and structured extractions against a human-adjudicated reference?
How well does an LLM evaluator identify correct, incorrect, and source-unassessable extracted fields, including controlled injected errors?
How do observed and calibrated screening, extraction, and technical failures change eligible meta-analyses and their conclusions?

secondary_estimands: screening specificity, precision, negative predictive value, balanced accuracy, and F1
field accuracy by case, field name, field class, null status, and source adequacy
raw human agreement, Cohen kappa, and Gwet AC1 before adjudication
evaluator predictive values and abstention rate
retrieval completeness, metadata conformance, and deduplication error rates
confidence-interval width, prediction interval, tau-squared, I-squared, and weight shifts
target_venue: ACM Journal of Data and Information Quality (JDIQ)

uncertainty_methods.domain_aggregation: descriptive only; no population-level domain claim
uncertainty_methods.exploratory_multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg correction within each declared family
uncertainty_methods.weighted_validation_estimands: 10,000-replicate stratified cluster bootstrap respecting sampling strata and record clustering

units_of_analysis.call: one attempted model API operation, including failed attempts
units_of_analysis.case: one purposively selected topic and retrieval configuration
units_of_analysis.estimate: one harmonized effect estimate for a defined estimand
units_of_analysis.field: one requested structured value for one record
units_of_analysis.study: one underlying independent study after report linkage

working_title: Data Quality and Error Propagation in LLM-Assisted Evidence Synthesis
